name: Sakura Succubus 9
source:
In the ninth part of the Sakura Succubus series, Hiroki returns to Astoria with Ayu as she prepares for the concert of a lifetime: a joint show with her fellow idol Mihama Shizuru. Will this concert end in success, and will Hiroki's harem get even bigger?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2788150/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在《樱花魅魔》系列的第九部中，弘树与亚由一起回到阿斯托里亚，准备一场终生难忘的音乐会：与她的偶像美滨静的联合演出。这场演唱会能否圆满结束，弘树的后宫是否会更加壮大？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2788150/]Steam[/url]]
